scope: Existing source, data preparation, notebook runtime, scientific labels and tests. AR6 addition separately validated.

findings.trigger_condition: A dataset fetch fails, then Ctrl+Enter runs a query.
findings.potential_consequence: Prior values can acquire the failed dataset metadata.
findings.resolution: Readiness is cleared before loading; metadata commits after load; keyboard and button queries share the guard.

findings.trigger_condition: Generate the original illustrative rainfall equation.
findings.potential_consequence: 977 cell-months contain physically impossible negative rainfall.
findings.resolution: Raised the analytic offset to 90; regenerated stores and outputs; validation requires nonnegative rainfall.

findings.trigger_condition: Open the coastal scene with the former default filter.
findings.resolution: General default now includes every finite value; the deliberate Ngami cube threshold remains visible.

findings.trigger_condition: Refresh DE Africa data in a fresh clone.
findings.potential_consequence: The absent cache directory prevents the first download.
findings.resolution: Create the cache parent before raster retrieval.

findings.trigger_condition: Refresh data on a date other than the hardcoded date.
findings.potential_consequence: New downloads receive false retrieval provenance.
findings.resolution: Record actual UTC date only when retrieving new data; cached preparation preserves its date.

findings.trigger_condition: Source Zarr shape exceeds the bounded catalog shape.
findings.potential_consequence: Full oversized data are decoded before mismatch rejection.
findings.resolution: Actual source dimensions must match the catalog and the 100000-cell bound before reads.

findings.trigger_condition: Share an observed GeoJSON outside the course.
findings.potential_consequence: Exact source items and transformations are no longer traceable.
findings.resolution: Python and JavaScript exports link exact provenance; AR6 exports also retain scenario, workflow and baseline.

findings.trigger_condition: Use Ctrl+Enter after a failed dataset switch.
findings.potential_consequence: Old data export under different scientific meaning.
findings.resolution: Same resolution as A1; independent corroboration retained.

findings.guard_snippet: Reject mismatched dimensions before value reads.
findings.potential_consequence: Large allocations bypass the advertised memory bound.
findings.resolution: Same resolution as A6; independent corroboration retained.

findings.trigger_condition: Click Reset view before initial metadata arrives.
findings.potential_consequence: Reset throws an uncaught TypeError during startup.
findings.resolution: Reset is guarded until metadata and Deck exist and loading has finished.

findings.trigger_condition: Refresh a fresh clone with no cache directory.
findings.resolution: Same resolution as A4; independent corroboration retained.

findings.trigger_condition: Refresh after the original fixed retrieval date.
findings.potential_consequence: Provenance misstates when data were downloaded.
findings.resolution: Same resolution as A5; independent corroboration retained.

findings.guard_snippet: Copy provenance when preparing the data.
findings.potential_consequence: Notebook provenance remains stale while values change.
findings.resolution: Preparation synchronizes notebook provenance; validation compares notebook and public copies.

findings.trigger_condition: Browser decoding or Arrow insertion changes value-coordinate association.
findings.guard_snippet: Assert 127 selected rows and a known coordinate/value.
findings.potential_consequence: Scientifically incorrect observed maps can pass broad count checks.
findings.resolution: Browser integration checks the exact Ngami selection and exported geographic/value reference.
findings.evidence: Baseline browser test asserted only a nonempty subset; unit flattening test bypassed Zarr and Arrow. Source reference: row14 col40 lon22.83625 lat-20.425520833333334 value0.7045454383.

findings.trigger_condition: The mode-change render handler stops working.
findings.guard_snippet: Assert visible time support and axis explanation per mode.
findings.potential_consequence: Persistent canvas visibility conceals broken view switching.
findings.resolution: Browser tests verify all-time cube versus current-slice counts and the vertical-axis meaning.
findings.evidence: Baseline mode test checked only the same persistent canvas; removal of the handler would leave the assertion true.

findings.trigger_condition: A Pyodide error appears in a virtualized off-screen cell.
findings.guard_snippet: Clear outputs; inspect every model output and final completion marker.
findings.potential_consequence: A partial notebook run passes DOM-only checks.
findings.resolution: Browser tests inspect complete notebook models, errors and execution counts for five lessons, including all new AR6 notebooks.
findings.evidence: Baseline test waited for Busy/Idle then inspected mounted DOM errors and only the first import output; native notebook tests cannot establish Pyodide compatibility.
